channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Kroenke | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Kroenke from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Josh Kroenke, Michael Malone, Calvin Booth
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on the Nuggets firing Michael Malone and Calvin Booth:

“Iknew a little bit before everybody. And (Josh Kroenke) told me, ‘We made a decision.’ So it was not a discussion. It was a decision, and he told me why. So I listened and I accept it.”

Nikola Jokic on Josh Kroenke, Michael Malone, Calvin Booth, Apr 10, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Michael Malone on Tim Connelly:

“I wouldn't have this job without Tim Connelly. Tim Connelly after my brief tenure in Sacramento and our time working together in New Orleans for many years, saw something in me, where he believed in me to tell Josh Kroenke I was the right guy for the job.”

Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly, May 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Calvin Booth on Masai Ujiri, Josh Kroenke
item.description:
Booth told The Post this week.

“I also think Josh (Kroenke) and (former GM) Masai (Ujiri) deserve credit.… They did the Carmelo (Anthony) trade, and the Carmelo trade ended up being a lot of different assets that helped this team get to this point, one of them being Jamal (Murray) with the pick-swap. I feel like each iteration of the front office has helped contribute to get to this point.”

Calvin Booth on Masai Ujiri, Josh Kroenke, May 27, 2023. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
Malone:

“It’s not about me, obviously. For the Kroenke family to show that kind of belief in me going forward means the world. The best part is getting the news out now so we can turn the page and get ready for the game tonight.”

Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke, Oct 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @NickKosmider.

item.title: Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
“So we’re in the back, in the coach’s locker room, and (Nuggets president) Josh (Kroenke) came in and grabbed me and hugged me, and said ‘I’m so proud of this team,’”

Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke, Sep 29, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
“We’re together, we’re one, we communicate, and I think that’s so important. But at the end of the day, Tim’s job as GM is to make those decisions, obviously with the blessing of Josh Kroenke. They asked my opinion, I gave it, I tell him what I feel and believe in, and then whatever decision they make I roll with it.”

Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke, Aug 17, 2015. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Tom Penn on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
“The fact that McGee is hurt really hurts them, I think, because he would be somebody who would be intriguing on the market. (Team president) Josh Kroenke has done a nice job of adding players at good numbers, which always means they are tradeable. It means they are an asset instead of a log on your (salary) cap. So they have the flexibility to get different. The trick is how to get better.”

Tom Penn on Josh Kroenke, Feb 23, 2014. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Brian Shaw on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Shaw confirmed that he had been hired by Denver during an exclusive interview with ESPNLosAngeles.com's Ramona Shelburne.

“I'm so appreciative for the opportunity to be able to lead this team and for the faith that [Nuggets team president] Josh Kroenke and [general manager] Tim Connelly have put in me,”

Brian Shaw on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly, Jun 24, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: George Karl on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
Nuggets ownership was steadfast that Karl would need to finish out the final season on his current contract before rewarding a coach who hadn't won a playoff series since 2009.

“I have high praise for the way Josh Kroenke handled this situation — he was always sincere and straightforward,”

George Karl on Josh Kroenke, Jun 7, 2013. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Warren LeGarie on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
Ramona Shelburne:LeGarie:

“[Josh Kroenke] was always straightforward and honest & very clear about what they were prepared and not prepared to do.”

Warren LeGarie on Josh Kroenke, Jun 6, 2013. Source: Twitter @ramonashelburne.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
Prior to his departure, Ujiri issued a statement expressing his gratitude to the Nuggets.

“First and foremost, I would like to thank Stan and Josh Kroenke for the opportunity they have given me over the past three years,”

Masai Ujiri on Josh Kroenke, May 31, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Josh Kroenke
item.description:
Ujiri said there was never any thought to leaving Denver.

“It wasn't a tough decision for me. As long as this guy (Kroenke) doesn't kick me out, I'm here for whenever,”

Masai Ujiri on Josh Kroenke, Oct 2, 2012. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: George Karl on Masai Ujiri, Josh Kroenke
item.description:
“But in the same sense, I think we've got to be a little cautious of being too optimistic. But the summer is fun for us. We've always loved the summer.... And hey, we've got good young players. In the end we might have too many good young players, but that's going to be Masai (Ujiri, Nuggets executive VP of basketball operations) and his (team president Josh Kroenke's) problem. My problem is to make them as confident and ready to go next year.”

George Karl on Masai Ujiri, Josh Kroenke, Jun 12, 2012. Source: Denver Post.
